top_5_issues.frequency_and_impact: Very common (≈10 reviews); high impact as users lose irreplaceable photos.
top_5_issues.root_cause_summary: Sync‑out‑of‑sync alerts and aggressive cloud deletion remove local files without clear warnings; out‑of‑space errors also trigger loss.
representative_quotes: Lost nearly 550 photos this is insane??
It deleted 10 GB of my photos
wont open, says its out of space
it removes my photos from the screen
My account was hacked and all of my photos are gone
top_5_issues.actionable_recommendation: Introduce a confirmation step before cloud‑initiated deletions, add a reversible trash for local files, and improve out‑of‑space handling with clear alerts.

top_5_issues.frequency_and_impact: Frequent (≈6 reviews); severe impact as core photo discovery stops working.
top_5_issues.root_cause_summary: Recent AI updates override traditional search, face grouping, and similarity stacks, leading to inaccurate results and UI clutter.
representative_quotes: AI updates have made this app unusable
Why is face grouping not working even though I have it enabled
the AI will just tell you that it didn't have what you were looking for
I don't want any similar stack now
top_5_issues.actionable_recommendation: Separate AI suggestions from core search, allow users to toggle AI features, and restore reliable face/grouping functionality.

top_5_issues.issue_title: Lack of Backup Control & Forced Storage Costs
top_5_issues.frequency_and_impact: Common (≈4 reviews); moderate impact due to unexpected mobile data usage and inability to delete.
top_5_issues.root_cause_summary: No Wi‑Fi‑only backup option and restrictive deletion policies force users to consume data and pay for extra storage.
representative_quotes: no "only backup using wifi" my months mobile data was completely used up
you can't delete the photos later on. It forces you to pay the subscription
No option to delete only on drive
top_5_issues.actionable_recommendation: Add a Wi‑Fi‑only backup toggle, simplify bulk‑delete with optional permanent removal, and clarify storage‑plan options.

top_5_issues.frequency_and_impact: Moderate (≈5 reviews); reduces usability and visual consistency.
top_5_issues.root_cause_summary: Recent UI redesign introduced uneven thumbnail sizes and removed familiar editing tools, confusing users.
representative_quotes: add a setting to make all thumbnails exactly the same size
the update removed the edit video options
top_5_issues.actionable_recommendation: Standardize thumbnail dimensions, restore removed video‑edit controls, and provide an optional classic UI mode.

top_5_issues.frequency_and_impact: Moderate (≈5 reviews); hampers trust in backup reliability.
top_5_issues.root_cause_summary: Sync inconsistencies and locked‑folder handling cause backed‑up photos and videos to disappear from the app.
representative_quotes: doesn't show all my photos in my account
can't find some of my pictures and videos that were already backed up
I can't find some of the pictures I even put in the locked folder
top_5_issues.actionable_recommendation: Implement a sync health dashboard, ensure locked‑folder items are always visible, and add a recovery tool for missing backed‑up media.

overall_sentiment_summary: Negative sentiment dominates, with users reporting data loss, broken AI/search features, uncontrolled data usage, UI regressions, and inaccessible backed‑up content.
